notes:
Two more fixes on top of 0.17, both confirmed on real tablets.

**The second tablet's screen could stay blank.** With two tablets paired, the second one sometimes showed nothing at all when a piece was opened — the screen would even blink, as if it were about to show something, and then stay empty. Closing and reopening the app was the only way out.

The tablet was asking the screen to refresh, but never asking the app to actually redraw the page first, so the screen faithfully refreshed an empty picture. It only affected the second tablet, because the first one is driven by your own taps and a tap causes a redraw as a side effect; the second is driven entirely over the wireless link, where nothing did.

**The page cleanup filters no longer slow the reader down.** With "Darker" or "Sharper" turned on, turning pages and opening a piece could become noticeably sluggish on a scanned piece. The filter was being recalculated across the whole page every time anything on screen changed — every stroke of writing, every mark placed, every page turn — even though the result never changes.

It is now worked out once, when the page is first drawn, and reused after that. Turning pages with a filter on is now as quick as with it off. Nothing about how the filters look has changed, and they remain display-only: your PDF is never altered, and you can switch a filter off at any time.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
